name: Dame! tte Itta no ni...
original_name: ダメッ! っていったのに…
source:
"You" ask to see cute schoolgirl Madoka piss her panties after everyone goes home from school. Shame and urination play on an empty campus.

The 3rd urine themed visual novel from Himeshibori.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ100541.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

“你”要求在大家放学回家后看可爱的女学生小圆尿内裤。羞耻和小便在空荡荡的校园里上演。

姬堀的第三部尿液主题视觉小说。
